logo-red.purpose: Owns whole fields only where a page closes (people band, request band), the hero facts module and the phone block; marks action (hover, nav current bar, link underline, focus, selection). Full strength only; the ramp is reference, the system never uses tints.

ink.purpose: All text, 2px sheet rules and 1px hairlines, ink actions, active segments, the photo caption bar, all numbering (nav, index, services, operations).

paper.purpose: Page stock, the hero headline field, and all type set on red or ink.

stone.purpose: Default border, quiet secondary rules (mobile menu dividers), hover fill of segmented controls and the menu cell.

mid-grey.purpose: Secondary text only: intake notes, operation notes, spec keys, captions under part photos, index column heads, machine types.

display.purpose: Hero statement only; wdth 125, capped per locale so the longest line fits the headline field.

page-title.purpose: Factual two-line sentence titles on machines, about and contact; same cut as display, up to 4.25rem.

statement.purpose: The heading of a red band.

title.purpose: Operation titles, service names, machine names in the index, people's names, intake values; wdth 112.

lead.purpose: First paragraph of a sheet and the hero body; measure about 36rem.

small.purpose: Notes, captions, machine types and makers, footer.

label.purpose: Uppercase register keys, intake captions, folios, sub-list headings, index column heads.

figure.purpose: Large figures and phone numbers; every number everywhere is tabular.

rules.name: sheet-rule
rules.purpose: Opens every sheet, register, index and the header bottom.

rules.name: soft-rule
rules.purpose: Default border; quiet dividers in the mobile menu.

rules.name: column-tick
rules.value: 1px x 10px, 12 per sheet (7 on the hero field)

motion.name: tick-wipe
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0); 1100ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), 120ms delay, once
motion.purpose: The single load motion: the hero's seven-tick line draws across the paper headline field.

motion.name: procession-track
motion.value: transform scaleX(0) to scaleX(1); 1600ms steps(4, jump-start), once on 50% intersection
motion.purpose: Red track runs across the four operations. The process sheet is currently hidden on the home page.

motion.name: spec-deploy
motion.purpose: Spec sheet opening in place from a machine index row.

motion.name: drill-cycle
motion.value: JS timeline from src/data/drillCycle.ts, about 23s per loop; new part wipes in from the left between loops; pauses offscreen and in hidden tabs
motion.purpose: The looping hero plate: G83 peck-drilling section drawing with the X/Z/S/F readout. No red. Play/pause control on the ink bar under the plate, no caption text.

motion.name: underline-bar
motion.purpose: Desktop nav hover/current red bar; closed index rows nudge their arrow down 3px (160ms ease-out).

motion.name: page-turn
motion.value: cross-document view transition: new root clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0) 440ms cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.15, 1) over a static old root; nav-current bar group 380ms same curve; site-header held
motion.purpose: Between pages the header holds, the red current bar travels to the new nav item and the next sheet wipes in from the left.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation and transition durations 0.01ms; tick wipe off; procession never armed (track shows complete); hero drawing holds its server-rendered still frame; no page view transition (instant swap)

focus.value: outline 3px solid #e30016, offset 2px; white outline inside red fields

photography.caption: Plain caption only; no FOTO NN / PHOTO NN plate numbers (dropped 2026-11-22, read as placeholders). Ink caption bar under the hero plate, mid grey under part photos.
photography.cutouts: machine cutouts multiplied onto paper (mix-blend-mode multiply); caption ends 'manufacturer image' until the client's own photographs replace them

openItems: The four parts photographs on the home page are real parts from the shop (confirmed by the client, 2026-11-16).
The contact map is third-party content and loads only when the visitor asks for it.
Machine images are manufacturer cutouts multiplied onto the paper, not plates of the client's own machines.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Identity Manual"**

The site is the firm's own 1970s-style corporate identity manual: every section is a numbered sheet that opens on a heavy ink rule, with the twelve columns of the page grid drawn as ticks hanging from that rule. White stock, ink type, and the logo red at full strength owning whole fields. Order is the message: an orderly page reads as an orderly shop.

Density is that of a reference document, not a brochure. Facts are set in registers (label left, value right, hairline under each row), machines are an index of numbered rows, the process is a sequence of numbered operations. Photography is shown in natural colour with plain captions; the hero plate is a technical drawing. There are no cards, no shadows, no blur, no rounded corners; structure comes only from grid modules and rules. The previous cream, glow-and-frosted-glass system was discarded entirely and nothing from it carries over.
keyCharacteristics: One logo red at full strength, owning at most one closing field per page (people band, request band) and marking action; never tinted, never a gradient. In the hero, red owns only the contained facts module; the headline field is paper and ink (client direction, 2026-11-21).
Sheets open on a 2px ink rule with the visible 12-column tick line and a folio ("List 02" / "Sheet 02") on the rule at the right.
One family, Archivo Variable, with the wide cut for display and tabular figures for every number.
Registers, indexes and numbered operations instead of cards.
Natural-colour photography with plain captions (no plate numbers).

One load motion (the tick-line wipe across the headline field), one looping hero plate (the drilling drawing, see Plates), one scroll procession (the stepped red track over the operations; that sheet is currently hidden on the home page) and one page turn (between pages the header holds, the red current bar travels to the new nav item and the next sheet wipes in from the left).

rules.name: The Full-Strength Rule
rules.body: Red appears at 100% or not at all. No tints, no opacity, no gradients, no red-on-red tones. A red area is a whole field or a whole action, never a wash.

rules.name: The Red Means Owned-Or-Action Rule
rules.body: Red either owns an entire region of the grid or marks something the buyer can act on. The manual's numbering is ink. Red is never decoration on an otherwise neutral block.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo only. Hierarchy is made with width and weight, never with a second face.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number is set with tabular figures so registers, indexes and phone numbers align like a printed table.

rules.name: The Visible Grid Rule
rules.body: The twelve columns are drawn, not implied. New sheets open with the tick-line rule, and content snaps to the columns those ticks mark.

rules.name: The Folio-On-The-Rule Rule
rules.body: Sheet numbers sit on the rule at the right edge, small and tabular. Nothing small and uppercase is stacked above a heading.

rules.name: The Rules-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: Separate with a rule or a field, never with a shadow, a card or a floating panel.

dos: Do let logo red own an entire grid region or mark an action, at full strength only.
Do open every sheet with the 2px ink rule, the twelve-tick line and a folio on the rule at the right.
Do build content as registers, indexes and numbered sequences separated by 2px rules and 1px hairlines.
Do set every number in tabular figures and number things the way a manual does (01, 010).
Do show photography in natural colour with a plain caption, no plate number.

Do keep motion to the tick-line wipe on load, the stepped procession track, the spec-sheet deploy, the page turn between pages (CSS cross-document view transition, 440ms wipe, 380ms bar travel) and short linear state changes; under reduced motion all of it stops (the hero drawing holds its still frame, the track shows complete and pages swap instantly).
donts: Don't tint, fade or gradient the red, or use a second accent color.
Don't use shadows, blur, glass, rounded corners or cards.
Don't set a small uppercase label above a heading; folios belong on the rule, and labels key registers or name sub-lists.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a system display face; width and weight of Archivo carry the hierarchy.
Don't filter, tint, duotone or desaturate photographs, and don't add plate numbers ("FOTO 01") back to captions.
Don't add icon glyphs beyond the drawn 2px arrow, the phone stroke and the play/pause stroke.
